payload.title: Hashtags for concepts (one helper in Python and TypeScript)
payload.description:
Hashtag = name part of the SemanticNode nodeKey (knowledge_snapshot/keys.py entity_key builds it): concept--voice-cloning -> #voice-cloning. When two kinds share a name, show '#translation (task)'. One Python helper next to entity_key and one TS helper in lib/ (lib/wiki.ts), with shared test vectors. Parse '#name' back to candidate nodes (exact key match first).
Tests: round trip; collision display.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
